fishing: WHEN: early/moving tides. PASSES-BEACH: snook C&R, redfish, jacks/whiting/pompano Stump Pass/Manasota/Blind Pass. LEMON BAY: redfish schools (Turtle/Smokehouse), snook shorelines/docks, trout. NEARSHORE: mangrove/lane snapper, grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, cut mullet, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis not observed statewide past week; background only SWFL.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (~20 CFU); Charlotte sites clear.
